snippet.title: ToneTrek – Gameplay Demo (Visual Styles Preview)
snippet.description:
Here's another quick look at ToneTrek, our upcoming logic puzzle game where every step changes a tile’s color.

In this demo, we’re showing off some of the visual tile styles available in the game — but please note:

⚠️ Changing tile styles during gameplay is not a feature — it’s shown here for demonstration purposes only.

🔹 Match color patterns by stepping through tiles
🔹 Plan your route and solve handcrafted levels
🔹 Choose your favorite color scheme and tile style
🔹 Relaxed and strategic puzzle experience

📌 Learn more: https://darkwatersgames.com/tonetrek
📣 Follow us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61564462991559

🎮 A playable demo will be available on Steam soon!

#ToneTrek #PuzzleGame #IndieDev #LogicGame #GameplayDemo #SteamDemo
